queries:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT zoneref, traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM f
)
SELECT f.zoneref,
       f.traitcount,
       CAST(f.traitcount AS REAL) / t.total AS share,
       CAST(f.traitcount AS REAL) / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS margin
FROM f, t
WHERE CAST(f.traitcount AS REAL) / t.total > 1.0 / t.n
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT SUM(traitcount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM scanfeatures;
SELECT SUM(traitcount), AVG(traitcount) FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL AND traitcount <> 0;
